Class.name: IHC.ITF.Transform.Dtl.ThreeMAdtHl7ToCernBarWorkingDrg
Class.Description: Transform HDM ADT message to Cerner DFT message

XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='Billing3M:ADT_Billing3M' targetDocType='HDMBilling:ADT_Billing' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Billing from HDM to Cerner</annotation> <trace value='"### MSH Mapping"' /> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Utility).GetHddObject(context.hddNcidResponse, "MSH:ReceivingFacility")' property='hddObject' action='set' /> <if condition='hddObject '=""' > <true> <if condition='hddObject.Rep '=""' > <true> <trace value='hddObject.Rep_":::MSH:ReceivingFacility"' /> <assign value='hddObject.Rep' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingFacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{MSH:VersionID.versionID} '= ""' > <true> <assign value='source.{MSH:VersionID.versionID}' property='target.{MSH:VersionID.versionID}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='"2.3"' property='target.{MSH:VersionID.versionID}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <trace value='source.{EVN}' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <trace value='"### PID Mapping"' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <if condition='..Contains(source.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID},"-")' > <true> <assign value='..Piece(source.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID},"-",2)' property='target.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <trace value='"### PV1 Mapping the 1st ocurence."' /> <assign value='source.{PV1(1)}' property='target.{PV1}' action='set' /> <trace value='"### DG1 Mapping ###"' /> <foreach property='source.{DG1()}' key='k1' > <if condition='source.{DG1(k1):DiagnosisType} = "W"' > <true> <assign value='source.{DG1(k1)}' property='target.{DG1(k1)}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <trace value='"DG1(" _k1_ ") : Diagnosis Type code is NOT the expected 'W'. "' /> </false> </if> </foreach> <trace value='"### DRG Mapping ###"' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):DiagnosticRelatedGroup}' property='target.{DRG(1):DiagnosticRelatedGroup}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):DRGAssignedDateTime}' property='target.{DRG(1):DRGAssignedDateTime}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):DRGApprovalIndicator}' property='target.{DRG(1):DRGApprovalIndicator}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):DRGGrouperReviewCode}' property='target.{DRG(1):DRGGrouperReviewCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):OutlierType}' property='target.{DRG(1):OutlierType}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):OutlierDays}' property='target.{DRG(1):OutlierDays}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):OutlierCost}' property='target.{DRG(1):OutlierCost}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):DRGPayor}' property='target.{DRG(1):DRGPayor}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):OutlierReimbursement}' property='target.{DRG(1):OutlierReimbursement}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DRG(1):ConfidentailIndicator}' property='target.{DRG(1):ConfidentailIndicator}' action='set' /> <trace value='"*****************End of Mapping****************************"' /> </transform>
